title_zh: 把选举提问交给合适的候选人

scenario.label_zh: 区分不同层级的选举议题
scenario.goal_zh: 澄清地方与联邦候选人职责的区别并分别整理待问问题。

context_zh: 在虚构的公民教育练习中，同学为候选人问答会准备问题。
author: author-phase05-b

sentences.speaker: Daria
sentences.text: For our election exercise, can I ask the council candidate in our district about national immigration policy?

sentences.speaker: Noah
sentences.text: You can ask for their opinion, but the worksheet says that issue is handled by the federal government in this fictional country.

sentences.speaker: Daria
sentences.text: Then it would not test what they could actually do in the council.

sentences.speaker: Noah
sentences.text: Exactly. Your question about the closed local playground fits their role better.

sentences.speaker: Daria
sentences.text: I will ask when they would reopen it and how they would pay for repairs.

sentences.speaker: Noah
sentences.text: Keep the immigration question on a separate page for the national candidates.

sentences.speaker: Daria
sentences.text: Good. I now have one set of questions for each level rather than mixing them together.
